about_the_game:
After receiving a mysterious plea for help from an old friend, Lucas Usher returns to the secretive rooms and darkened halls of the Bariton mansion, only to find them empty. Where there used to be people, now there are only whispers of secrets left behind.

In your exploration you encounter faint echoes of who these people once were. Ghostly entities known as Resonants. What happened to this place and the people who lived here? And where is your friend?

Resonant Dusk is a tribute to the horror adventure games of the 90s, with a few modern upgrades. It offers a chilling narrative, inspired by the gothic tales of old, about the darker side of the human condition.

Navigate the mansion and its myriad of rooms. Uncover its secrets and use what you find to solve the riddles keeping the spirits bound to our mortal plane of existence. Each ghost has a story, and a longing for resolution. It’s up to you to help them find it. But will you offer redemption, or will you be the hand of doom?

  • Explore the enigmatic Bariton mansion through fixed camera angles and classic tank controls.

  • Interact with the lingering spirits within to unveil the mansion's secrets.

  • Solve puzzles using items and your wit to progress further into the mansion.

  • Experience the haunting narrative and eerie atmosphere.

  • Witness the outcome of your choices in multiple endings.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: 2.0 ghz dual core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia, AMD, or Intel OpenGL 4.0 / DirectX 11 graphics.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Unravel the secrets of the Bariton mansion! Take on the mantle of detective in the role of Lucas Usher, and solve the riddles plaguing the ghosts of those left behind! Uncover their secrets and help them find salvation … or damnation.
